# Tournament bracket generator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/tournament-bracket/

Create a single-elimination bracket with byes and editable match winners. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Enter six players, generate a bracket and select winners as each match is played.

## Limits and checks

This creates a local bracket, not a live tournament service. Later rounds reset when an earlier winner is changed.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
